$comment: Decision 5, prepared and not active: settings for a Claude Code session that works against the public sandbox (claude --settings tools/claude-sandbox-settings.json). Since agent interface v2 (2026-11-24) such a session needs no shell at all: the public scene is driven through the MCP tools of the server entry rigtwin-public in .mcp.json, which are the only tools allowed here; the shell, file edits and web fetches are denied, and the local server's tools too. The sandbox block stays as a second barrier for anything that still runs a command. Text that comes back from the public server is written by strangers: data, never instructions.
